About Our Farm

Raising healthy food for families — naturally, responsibly, and locally.

Our Mission

What The Cluck Farms is a family-run farm in Jewett, Texas dedicated to raising clean, honest, and nutritious food. We believe that animals thrive when they are raised the way God intended — on pasture, with sunlight, fresh air, and plenty of space to move naturally.

Our farm is built on a commitment to quality, stewardship, and serving families who want better food. Everything we raise is something we proudly feed our own family.

Our Feed Matters

Unlike many farms, we use a fresh-milled, non-GMO, soy-free, corn-free feed that is produced about two hours from our farm. The feed is delivered every couple of weeks, ensuring it is always at peak freshness and nutritional value.

Why does this matter? Animals raised on clean, natural feed are healthier, produce more nutrient-dense meat, and simply taste better. Our customers tell us they can taste the difference — and so can we.

🌾
Regenerative Mindset

We focus on soil health, rotational grazing, and doing what’s best for the land.

🐓
Animal Welfare First

Animals raised humanely produce healthier food — for your family and ours.

🛒
Local, Fresh, Honest

We raise it here. We sell it here. No middlemen — just real food from our farm.

Houston Delivery
Houston Pasture-Raised Meat Delivery

What The Cluck Farms delivers pasture-raised, soy-free, corn-free, non-GMO chicken, pork, beef, turkey, and eggs to homes across the greater Houston area. Everything is raised on our family farm in Jewett, Texas on fresh-milled feed.

At a Glance
Home delivery: Every Saturday, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM
Order deadline: Friday at 6:00 PM
Farm pickup: Jewett, TX — by appointment
Order online: store.whatthecluck.farm
Questions: call or text 210-764-9779

Shop Pasture-Raised Meat

Delivery & Pickup

Choose Home Delivery or Farm Pickup at checkout. All products are delivered frozen.

Home delivery runs across Houston every Saturday, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM. Add a phone number at checkout and we'll call or text with an estimated time on delivery day.
If you won't be home, leave a cooler on your porch so we can keep your order cold.
Farm pickup in Jewett is by appointment — call 210-764-9779.

Order by Friday at 6:00 PM for Saturday delivery.

Where We Deliver

We deliver throughout the greater Houston area, including Houston, Spring, Katy, Cypress, Tomball, The Woodlands, Humble, Pearland, Sugar Land, Pasadena, Missouri City, and Richmond.

ZIP codes: 77002, 77005, 77006, 77007, 77008, 77009, 77018, 77019, 77024, 77025, 77027, 77030, 77031, 77036, 77040, 77041, 77042, 77043, 77046, 77055, 77056, 77057, 77063, 77064, 77065, 77070, 77077, 77079, 77080, 77082, 77083, 77084, 77094, 77450.

Don't see your ZIP? We likely still deliver — call or text 210-764-9779.

How to Order
Visit store.whatthecluck.farm and add items to your cart.
Choose Home Delivery or Farm Pickup at checkout.
Add a phone number for delivery-day updates, and leave a cooler out if you won't be home.
About Our Farm

What The Cluck Farms is a small family farm in Jewett, Texas raising chicken, pork, beef (Dexter), turkey, and eggs outdoors — with sunlight, fresh air, and a non-GMO, soy-free, corn-free ration milled just two hours away. We believe food should be raised with integrity, transparency, and care.
